decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - That part of the building that is hereby permitted to be used for an education and training centre, shall be used only as an education and training centre and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 or any Order revoking and re-enacting that Order), unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Change of use from offices to use as classrooms for educational training centre.
